يستنكح (form X)
# يَسْتَنْكِحُ (yastankiḥu) /jas.tan.ki.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْكَحَ (istankaḥa)
# يُسْتَنْكَحُ (yustankaḥu) /jus.tan.ka.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْكَحَ (istankaḥa)
# يَسْتَنْكِحَ (yastankiḥa) /jas.tan.ki.ħa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْكَح
